source.notes: The Home Depot (D1-class thermal): body is single-width. The tilted-square THE HOME DEPOT wordmark + 'How doers get more done.' slogan is a printed logo graphic (logo band, never scaled body text). Rules shared by stylescan and the renderer; ported from the legacy _HOMEDEPOT_RULES plus survey/return-policy lines from the 2026-09-20 dumps.

rules.pattern: NAIL IT|short survey|GIFT CARD|homedepot\.com/survey|User ID|PASSWORD|Opine en|No purchase necessary|Entries must
PRO XTRA MEMBER|PRO XTRA .*SUMMARY|PO/JOB|PRO XTRA SPEND|CREDIT LINE|Perks|Apply and SAVE|homedepot\.com/credit|RETURN POLICY|POLICY ID|POLICY EXPIRES|Pro Xtra, register|Learn more at
